GitHub - devicons/devicon: Set of icons representing programming languages, designing & development tools

name: Devicon
summary: Icon set of logos for programming languages, frameworks and development tools, usable as a font or SVG.
description: An icon collection gathering logos that represent development languages, frameworks and tools. Each icon comes in several versions — font/SVG, original/plain/line, colored or not, with or without a wordmark — and can be used via the devicon font (npm/yarn or CDN), copy-pasted SVG, or an img tag; the site offers a searchable gallery that writes the code for you. MIT licensed and community-contributed through GitHub.
contains: icons for programming languages, designing and development tools
each icon in original, plain and line versions; colored or mono; with or without wordmark
font, SVG, npm/yarn and CDN usage; copy-paste snippets on the site
